crossRefs.note: giving thanks always concerning all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, to God, even the Father;
In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to…
Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father, through him.
He said, “Naked I came out of my mother’s womb, and naked will I return there. Yahweh gave, and Yahweh has taken away.…
I will bless Yahweh at all times. His praise will always be in my mouth.
Through him, then, let’s offer up a sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of lips which proclaim…
For this is the will of God: your sanctification, that you abstain from sexual immorality,
For this is the will of God, that by well-doing you should put to silence the ignorance of foolish men:
that you no longer should live the rest of your time in the flesh for the lusts of men, but for the will of God.
The world is passing away with its lusts, but he who does God’s will remains forever.

parallels.note: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for all of you, that your faith is proclaimed throughout the whole world.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus toward you.
translations.bsb: Give thanks in every circumstance, for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.
translations.kjv: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.
translations.asv: in everything give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus to you-ward.
